messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: Forecast gaps hotlist + owner pledges (Finance checkpoint)

Team —

Quick note ahead of Friday's finance checkpoint: Finance needs a tightened forecast for Q2 by EOD Tuesday (May 11). We currently sit at ~0.85x coverage vs. target (1.6x) for the ARR motion once adjusted for weighted close probabilities. To avoid an ad-hoc credit ask, we need a short hotlist + one-line owner pledge per at-risk deal.

What I need from each of you by EOD Mon (May 10):
- Top 6 deals you own that are in stages Opportunity / Negotiation (include HubSpot ID)
- Current best close date and the firmest commitment you have (firm / soft / TBD)
- Single bullet risk (e.g., procurement review, SOC 2 evidence, pricing hold)
- Pledge: what you will do this week to move to a firm commit (owner pledge, 2–3 actions)

I've attached a starter CSV (coverage_hotlist_Q2.csv) and pulled the most recent mutual action plan we shared with Acme. Use those as the template. Finance requested a consolidated one-pager they can forward to CFO with owner commitments.

Thanks — keep it terse. We will consolidate and I will send the rollup to Finance and the AE on the account.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Director, North America Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: coverage_hotlist_Q2.csv (stub), ACME_MutualActionPlan.xlsx (stub)

Marcus —

On my list: 6 prioritized deals, sending the CSV populated. Short versions below (will fill in HubSpot IDs in the sheet).

1) Acme Corp (RDW-ACME-2345) — best close: 2027-06-15 — commitment: soft (exec budget review next week) — risk: final procurement SOW/term negotiation — pledge: 1) Lock pricing call with procurement (Wed 5/12), 2) Send final SOW draft by EOD Tue 5/11, 3) Request formal approval email from CFO by 6/10.
2) Beta Retail — 2027-05-31 — firm — risk: internal PO timing — pledge: confirm PO owner and escalate if delayed.
3) Gamma Health — 2027-06-01 — soft — risk: security questionnaire outstanding — pledge: coordinate SOC2 evidence handoff with Security.
4) Delta Apps — 2027-05-28 — TBD — risk: pricing counter — pledge: one more pricing concession to close faster.
5) Epsilon Analytics — 2027-06-10 — soft — risk: legal redlines — pledge: offer contract playbook.
6) Zeta Media — 2027-05-25 — firm — risk: none immediate — pledge: finalize signatures.

I'll flag Acme as highest risk-to-target and can take point on the SOW/terms push with procurement. CSV attached.

Ben
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
